catalogIntro: One entry per workcell. Check its photographs and actual contents before opening; earlier publications stay with their workcell.
reportOpenedCurrent: Opened the latest report for this workcell.
catalogNoObservedScene: No object-level observed surfaces attached. Check the models' photograph and spatial evidence in the report.
modelReviewScope: Results describe the photographs, model and pose saved at review time. Review again after changes; this does not establish measured site dimensions.
modelReviewFamilyScope: Review scope: this object together with all its child components.
modelReviewNotConfigured: The shape-review service is not configured.
observed_reference_surface: Observed reference surface (not a complete object model)
identityVisibleSurfaceOnly: Covers only the visible surface in the source photograph; rear and occluded surfaces are not reconstructed.
identityInferredPlaneOnly: The visible plane is inferred from the photo outline and estimated depth; rear surfaces, occluded regions and thickness are not reconstructed.
identitySourceModelsOnly: Source models retained; no current model
identityModelStaleNote: The current model’s source changed, so it is not valid spatial evidence for this revision. Its asset and selection remain saved; review or regenerate it.
identitySuggestionSaved: Identity suggestion saved and shared. The original report is unchanged.
identityRetainMeasurement: Retain cross-group evidence; no child measurement
identityPreviewNote: Merge the records while retaining all photos, source models and measurements; select at most one current model. Identity does not fuse different poses or establish metric dimensions. CAD attachments update; EHS must be re-evaluated for the new revision.
identityDifferentPreviewNote: Record these as different objects for subsequent association. Their photos, models, measurements and object IDs remain separate.
identityUndecidedPreviewNote: Record the unresolved identity and missing evidence for further review. Both records and their sources remain separate.
identityPublicNote: Public reports save your identity suggestion without modifying the scene or publication.
identityNoPhoto: This record has no photo evidence to preview.
identityEvidenceMissing: No referenced photo or asset evidence is available for an identity decision.
identityStale: The base revision changed. Review again before applying.
identitySplit: Incorrect association: split into two records
identitySplitNote: Assign every observation, model and measurement explicitly. Evidence spanning groups is not copied automatically. Further splits can be made in the next revision.
identityMeasurementConflict: Source values remain separate; unresolved measurement conflicts are shown as unknown.
feedbackCopy: Feedback belongs to this report and object. Discuss photo evidence with the Agent; the published scene is unchanged.
feedbackAsk: Describe the issue or add evidence for this object…
feedbackSavedNoAgent: Feedback saved. Agent replies are not currently enabled.
feedbackBudgetExceeded: Feedback saved. The current reply allowance has been reached.
feedbackReplyFailed: Feedback saved, but the Agent reply failed.
feedbackOutcomeUnknown: Feedback saved. The Agent reply outcome is unconfirmed; it will not be called again automatically.
feedbackSendUnconfirmed: Sending could not be confirmed. Retry uses the same request without creating duplicate feedback.
feedbackSendRejected: Feedback was not sent. Check the error details.
feedbackMessageInvalid: Select an object and enter feedback between 1 and 8,000 characters.
feedbackNoPhotoEvidence: No photo evidence attached to this feedback
reportReferenceSurfaceNote: This is a spatial reference surface. Recorded width and depth describe observed extent, not equipment height or installation tilt.
reportAssessment_unavailable: Safety assessments could not be loaded
reportAssessment_unassessed: This revision has not been assessed for safety
reportAssessment_assessed: Safety assessments are saved for this revision
reportAssessmentScopeHint: Historical checks are retained below and do not establish compliance for this revision.
reportAssessmentSavedHint: Start with checks requiring attention, then inspect the objects, site evidence and rule applicability.
reportAttentionGeometry: objects lack 3D assets or have unconfirmed placement
reportStartAssessment: Confirm applicable rules and site evidence to begin assessment
blender_worker_unavailable: A Blender runtime was not available to this task.
asset_size_mismatch: The downloaded file is incomplete. Please retry.
reportDetectionMeaning: Saved image interpretation, missing candidates and filtering evidence. Records explicitly linked to scene objects can be selected.
reportUnassociated: Not associated with a current scene entity
reportFirst: One photograph. One complete workcell report.
reportFirstHint: Explore objects, space and safety evidence, then correct omissions or review findings.
reportSpatialHint: Select an object in the photo, 3D, plan or inventory to follow its position and evidence.
reportNoAnalysis: Photos are saved; object analysis is not available yet. Task outcomes and reasons are recorded below.
reportUnderstandingHint: This inventory comes from saved photo analysis. Select a row to inspect its object.
reportAssociationHint: Unconfirmed cross-photo associations are retained separately; observation counts are not confirmed object counts.
reportReviewHint: Mark omissions, add site evidence or review findings within this workcell. Published reports retain their original revision.
reportDrawHint: Drag a box on the source photo, then tell the Agent what is missing. The box, photo and selected object are included together.
reportCopyReason: This report is read only. Save a copy to add objects and review findings in your own workcell revision.
reportSaved: A new workcell revision is saved. Re-evaluate affected rules.
reportNativeExtents: Observed extent · native X / Y / Z
reportGroundExtents: Observed extent · width / depth / ground height
reportMeasurementNote: Observed extents, generated models and measured dimensions are separate. Uncalibrated values use model units; local-axis angle is not equipment installation tilt.
reportSelectDetails: Select an object to inspect position, dimensions, sources and missing evidence.
reportNoExports: No export files are attached to this revision yet. Source photos and scene JSON are available.
reportExactExport: Exports of this exact scene revision
reportExportHint: Viewing online needs no Blender installation. Download .blend to continue editing in Blender.

reportPinnedTasks: Only tasks whose input or output matches this revision are shown. Complete, incomplete and failed outcomes remain distinct.
reportHistoricalHint: Results and evidence from the source run are preserved. They have not been re-evaluated for this revision and are not current compliance findings.
reportCoordinateNote: Original CAD and current 3D retain their recorded coordinate systems. Only explicitly linked objects synchronize.
reportEmptyMetrics: No valid same-run, same-metric comparisons are attached.
reportSelectedEvidence: Photo evidence for the selected object
reportNoInterpretation: No separate image interpretation text is attached. Actual labels, localization and evidence gaps are shown below.
layerScaleSpread: (±{pct}%, the spread when each feature sets the scale alone)
layerScaleSource: ({source}). Model estimate, not verified by on-site measurement.
blender_export_timeout: Blender export timed out; this task did not finish the export.
sceneCadModelSource: CAD: current models and their saved poses
sceneCadFixedState: The workcell CAD uses fixed object reference states; changing photographs preserves its layout.
sceneReadOnly: Select an object to inspect its evidence and spatial bounds.
sceneCompositeEvidence: Composite source evidence · no independent model
sceneCompositeEvidenceMeaning: Shows the linked components’ actual models; unresolved source boundaries remain preserved.
sceneObservedCoverage: Photograph-visible region only, not a complete object model

sceneSelectEvidence: Select an object to inspect its observed evidence
sceneGeometryCoverage: object records have corresponding displayable geometry
sceneModelCoverage: object records have a displayable current model

sceneObjectModelMissing: No displayable current model for this object

sceneSelectionRetained: Objects remain selectable in photographs and the object list.
sceneFullscreenUnavailable: Fullscreen is unavailable. Use the single-view controls to expand a view.

sceneNoGeometrySelection: This object can be selected in the photograph; spatial geometry is not available.
sceneNoRepresentation: This revision has no spatial assets of the selected kind.

measure.title: Spatial measurements
measure.intro: Pick model surfaces to measure ground height, point distance and height difference, or a three-point sampled region.
measure.selectModelFirst: Select an object with a current model first.
measure.kind.region_ground: Sampled region ground heights · three points
measure.kind.bend: Panel interior bend · two sheet faces
measure.kind.edge_vertical: Edge angle to vertical · two points
measure.pointsAnyObject: Surface points may come from different objects.
measure.savedBend.measured: Calculated and saved during processing; loaded with the report.
measure.savedBend.unsupported: Processed: no stable bend detected in this model. Choose a detected bend above.
measure.savedBend.not_processed: No saved analysis for the current model.
measure.savedBend.skipped: No valid independent model for bend analysis.
measure.savedBend.failed: Processing could not complete this object's calculation.
measure.guide.point_ground: Pick a surface point. The red line reaches the ground along its normal; negative height is below ground.
measure.guide.point_distance: Pick A then B. Straight-line distance and signed B−A height difference are measured separately; height follows the ground normal.
measure.guide.region_ground: Pick three noncollinear surface points. The height range and inclination describe their sampled triangle, not the whole physical face.
measure.guide.edge_vertical: Pick the same sloping edge: ① upper endpoint (angle vertex) → ② lower endpoint. A vertical reference starts at ①; the green arc measures the edge angle to vertical.
measure.guide.edge_angle: Pick ① a point on the first edge → ② the shared vertex → ③ a point on the second edge. The second point is the angle vertex.
measure.pickedCount: {n}/{total} points selected. Click the mesh; drag to rotate. Or focus the canvas, use arrow keys to move the cursor and Enter to pick.
measure.bendExplain: Fit the two adjoining sheet faces of this panel and annotate their interior angle at the hinge. Flat = 180°, a right-angle fold = 90°. No ground or second object is used.
measure.inclinationExplain: Reference: scene ground. Horizontal = 0°, vertical = 90°. No second object is needed.
measure.regionSet: Temporary region set. It is not a verified safety zone.
measure.regionHow: Click two opposite rectangle corners in CAD, or move the cursor with arrow keys and press Enter.
measure.surfacesFound: {n} local surfaces saved; select one above.
measure.groundErrorUnknown: Ground direction error is unavailable; model inclination is an estimate, vertical classification is unverified.
measure.angularError: Engineering angular error estimate {deg}°; not field calibration.
measure.explain.region_ground: h gives the sampled triangle’s minimum and maximum signed ground heights; the angle is its inclination to ground.
measure.explain.point_distance: d is straight-line distance; Δh is the signed B−A ground height difference.
measure.explain.point_ground: h is signed height along the ground normal.
measure.explain.bend: Interior bend {deg}° ({flat}° from flat). Orange and blue identify the two fitted sheet faces; purple marks their hinge and green the interior angle.
measure.explain.edge_vertical: Edge angle to vertical: red is vertical, orange is the sloping edge, green is the measured angle. Vertex is ①. Vertical = 0°, horizontal = 90°.
measure.explain.edge_angle: 3D angle at point ② between the selected edge directions. Orange: the two lines. Yellow: angle arc. Obtuse angles are preserved. Accuracy depends on the points and model.
measure.explain.inclination: {deg}° to ground; {dev}° from vertical. Orange: fitted panel. Blue: a reference plane parallel to ground.
measure.explain.angle: The smaller angle between fitted planes, not a hinge interior or installation angle. A is orange; B is blue.
measure.explain.distance: Shortest line between mesh surfaces. Zero means contact or intersection.
measure.explain.occupancy: {pct}% of the drawn region. This is projected overlap, not solid collision.
measure.notVerified: Based on current model geometry and placement, not verified field measurements or a compliance verdict.
measure.nativeUnitsNote: Distances and areas use native model units.
measure.faceFit: Face {n}: {pct}% of mesh area; RMS residual {rms} native units.
